message.content:
Wafer dicing saws (such as the Disco DAD3430) fall under heading 8486, which covers machines used solely or principally for the manufacture of semiconductor devices. Within that heading, subheading 8486.20 covers machines for the manufacture of semiconductor devices or electronic integrated circuits. The specific line for dicing monocrystal wafers into chips is 8486.20.0010. I am not fully certain of the statistical suffix, but CBP rulings on dicing saws have pointed to this line.

{"hts_code": "8486.20.0010", "reason": "This is a diamond-blade dicing saw that cuts processed silicon wafers into individual integrated circuit chips, making it a machine used principally for manufacturing semiconductor devices or integrated circuits under subheading 8486.20."}
